description: Set a Cloud for WordPress site's WordPress version: `latest` follows releases; `previous` holds one major release back, the escape hatch when an update breaks the site (it then gets no newer releases until set back to `latest`). No pinned version numbers. Takes a few minutes.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: set_wordpress_version
title: Set Wordpress Version
